positive_sign: erosion (outward bank movement, away from channel)

last_rate_m_per_yr.derivation: annualised signed displacement of the most recent valid interval ending at or before the origin

last2_mean_rate_m_per_yr.derivation: mean of the last two valid interval rates ending at or before the origin

last3_mean_rate_m_per_yr.derivation: mean of the last three valid interval rates ending at or before the origin

acceleration_m_per_yr2.derivation: last rate minus the immediately previous rate

last_displacement_m.derivation: signed displacement of the most recent valid interval

last_interval_years.derivation: elapsed years of the most recent valid interval

last_interval_good.derivation: quality flag of the most recent interval

width_m.derivation: distance between the two outer bank intersections at the origin

width_change_last_m.derivation: width at the end minus width at the start of the most recent interval

abs_curvature_1_m.derivation: absolute local bankline curvature fitted over ±120 m at the origin

sinuosity.derivation: origin-year bank path length divided by straight-line distance over a five-transect window

is_left_bank.derivation: 1 for the left bank when facing downstream

horizon_years.derivation: target calendar year minus origin calendar year

elapsed_years.derivation: actual days between nominal 25 March dates divided by 365.25

excluded_on_purpose: transect_id and sample_id (stable identifiers, not predictors)
reach, along_m and coordinates (spatial identifiers; used only for reporting/evaluation)
any target-year bank position, area, rainfall, discharge or test-period observation

target.name: target_displacement_m
target.definition: signed bank displacement from origin to target; positive = erosion

low_movement.rationale: half of the 30 m Landsat pixel; near the minimum detectable bank change
